designationHistory.indexText: Bayou Sauvage Urban National Wildlife Refuge, established in 1990, contains a variety of wildlife habitats, including patches of bottomland hardwood forest; freshwater, brackish and estuarine tidal marshes; lagoons; canals; and natural bayous.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
